title: Global sections of a fixed pullback sheaf at cofiltered limits
statement: Let $J$ be a small nonempty cofiltered category, $D:J\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $c$ be a limit cone of $D$, let $R$ be any scheme, $\pi:D\to\mathrm{const}(R)$ a natural transformation, and $P:c.\mathrm{pt}\to R$ with $P=c_j\pi_j$ for every $j$. Let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $R_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Put $F_j=\pi_j^{-1}G$ and $F=P^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For $a:k\to j$ let $\tau_a:\Gamma(D_j,F_j)\to\Gamma(D_k,F_k)$ be pullback of global sections along $D(a)$ followed by the composition isomorphism of inverse images [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]; define $\tau_j:\Gamma(D_j,F_j)\to\Gamma(c.\mathrm{pt},F)$ similarly along $c_j$. These maps are the maps denoted by globalSectionsUpperStarMap followed by global sections of upperStarComp.inv in Lean. Every $t\in\Gamma(c.\mathrm{pt},F)$ equals $\tau_j(s)$ for some $j,s$. If $\tau_j(s)=0$, there is an arrow $a:k\to j$ with $\tau_a(s)=0$. No separation hypothesis on $R$ is imposed.

source.place: Theorem Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), degree p = 0; cofiltered reindexing by Categories Tag 0032 (lemma-directed-category-system).

proof.text: Use Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections followed by the inverse of Sheaf.H.equiv₀ to identify global sections with degree-zero cohomology. Its naturality for sheaf morphisms and compatibility with cohomologyMap identify every sectionTransition with cohomologyTriangleMap in degree zero. Transport the identity and composition laws of triangle maps across these isomorphisms. These laws construct the global-sections functor H on J opposite and its canonical cocone B with point Γ(c.pt,P inverse image G); the cone equation proves naturality of the legs.

Apply nonempty_isColimit_cofiltered_fixed_base_cohomology at q=0 to the supplied H and B, with the degree-zero/global-sections isomorphisms as eH and eB. The transition and leg equations follow from the comparison in step 1, cancelling the stage isomorphism for the transition equation. This gives IsColimit B. The cited continuity theorem carries out directed reindexing, compatible pullback-sheaf construction and the degree-zero instance of Tag 09YQ; none is duplicated here.

The forgetful functor from abelian groups preserves filtered colimits. Shrink its preservation instance from universe u+1 to u, the size of J. Apply Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep to H and B to obtain a stage representative of each section. If the leg at j kills s, compare s with zero at the same stage using Concrete.isColimit_exists_of_rep_eq. It supplies k and an arrow op j to k for which H.map sends s to H.map of zero, which is zero. Taking the opposite of that arrow gives k.unop to j and exactly the required eventual-vanishing witness.

lean.statement:
theorem globalSections_limit_comparison {R : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u}
    [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] (D : J ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (π : D ⟶ (Functor.const J).obj R) (c : Cone D) (P : c.pt ⟶ R)
    (hP : ∀ j, P = c.π.app j ≫ π.app j)
    [∀ j, CompactSpace (D.obj j)] [∀ j, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj j)]
    [∀ {j k : J} (f : j ⟶ k), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let Γ := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology A
    let F := fun {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ R) ↦ (upperStar A f).obj G
    let ρ := fun {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ R) (g : X ⟶ R)
      (w : g = h ≫ f) ↦ globalSectionsUpperStarMap A h (F f) ≫
        (Γ X).map ((upperStarComp A h f g w).inv.app G)
    (∀ t : (Γ c.pt).obj (F P), ∃ (j : J) (s : (Γ (D.obj j)).obj (F (π.app j))),
      ρ (c.π.app j) (π.app j) P (hP j) s = t) ∧
    ∀ (j : J) (s : (Γ (D.obj j)).obj (F (π.app j))),
      ρ (c.π.app j) (π.app j) P (hP j) s = 0 →
        ∃ (j' : J) (f : j' ⟶ j), ρ (D.map f) (π.app j) (π.app j') (by simp) s = 0
